clue.text: Beam given by that fellow exiting the pub

indicators.note: exiting says that fellow leaves the pub, so his letters come out of it

parts.note: a pub is a bar, so the pub is THE BAR
that fellow is HE

explanation.surface: A man walks out of the local, leaving a smile or a ray of light behind him.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking HE out of THE BAR leaves T BAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A T-bar is a metal girder with a T-shaped cross-section, a structural beam.

clue.text: Big tummy leads to the female's agitation

parts.note: a pot is a pot belly, a big tummy
the female's, the possessive, is HER

explanation.surface: A woman frets about her growing paunch.
explanation.definitionFit: Pother is an old word for fuss or commotion, a state of agitation.

clue.text: River finished with a hundred-fold increase in content

indicators.text: with a hundred-fold increase in content
indicators.note: the Roman numeral inside the word is multiplied by a hundred, so five becomes five hundred in its place

parts.note: finished means over

explanation.surface: A river's flow has ended, yet it swells a hundred times over.
explanation.walkthrough: In OVER the V is the Roman numeral 5; a hundredfold is 500, D.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oder is the central European river forming much of the border between Germany and Poland.

clue.text: Almost total mug, husband in fix

indicators.note: almost means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: a full-out mugging is an attack

explanation.surface: A married man gets himself into a hopeless fix after a real mugging.
explanation.definitionFit: To attach is to fasten or fix one thing to another.

clue.text: See people behind bars — honest-to-goodness!

parts.note: convicts in prison are cons
honest-to-goodness means genuine, true

explanation.surface: An exclamation of disbelief at the sight of prisoners locked up.
explanation.definitionFit: To see someone's meaning is to construe, or interpret, what they say.

clue.text: The artist, very short, a big noise being associated with Buddhist movement

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, stands for an artist
very in short form is V
a din is a big noise

explanation.surface: A painter, small and loud, gets involved with a Buddhist group.
explanation.walkthrough: Theravada is the oldest surviving school of Buddhism, strong in Sri Lanka and South-East Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Theravadin is the adjective describing the Theravada school of Buddhism and its followers.

clue.text: A load of directors with extra aspiration said to be very unpopular

indicators.note: said tells us the letters built are spoken, and their sound gives the answer

parts.words: A load of directors with extra aspiration
parts.note: a company's directors are a board; with extra aspiration, the breathy H, slipped in, A BOARD becomes A BHOARD

explanation.surface: A company board that talks too breathily is widely disliked.
explanation.walkthrough: Aspiration is the breathy H sound; adding one to A BOARD gives A BHOARD, which spoken sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something abhorred is loathed and detested, so it is extremely unpopular.

clue.text: See 15
Decline, having surrendered a prize

indicators.note: having surrendered means giving the letter up, so it is dropped

parts.note: to atrophy is to waste away or decline

explanation.surface: A competitor fades and has to give up the award.
explanation.definitionFit: A trophy is a cup or other award won as a prize.

clue.text: Walked with head out of sight and bent

indicators.note: the head of the word, its first letter, disappears

parts.note: marched means walked

explanation.surface: Someone trudges along with head bowed out of view, stooping.
explanation.definitionFit: Arched means curved like an arch, bent over.

clue.text: Once again state treasures will be moved, not for all to see

indicators.note: moved means the letters of treasures are shifted into a new order
not means the letter for general viewing is left out

parts.note: U is the British film certificate for films suitable for everyone

explanation.surface: A museum announces that some treasures are being moved out of public view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will be moved' rearranges TREASURES; 'not' removes U, the British film rating for all audiences.
explanation.definitionFit: To reassert is to state or insist on something again.

clue.text: Dissident eccentric a vain dark horse

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or irregular, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A strange, conceited outsider is labelled a troublemaker.
explanation.definitionFit: Andrei Sakharov, the Soviet nuclear physicist, became a famous dissident and human rights campaigner.

clue.text: What brings fame? Something other than competence evidently

parts.note: something other than a thing is not that thing
competence means ability

explanation.surface: A cynical question about celebrity: plainly, talent is not what makes people famous.
explanation.definitionFit: Notability, being notable or prominent, is the quality that earns renown.

clue.text: Heretic who may have a birthday in April

definitions.meaning: an ... followed Arius, whose teaching on Christ was condemned as heresy

definitions.text: who may have a birthday in April
definitions.meaning: someone born under Aries, whose dates run into April

explanation.surface: A heretic who happens to have been born in spring.
explanation.definitionFit: Arian names both a follower of the heretical teacher Arius and a person born under the star sign Aries.

clue.text: 'Fantastic singer' — it'd do for him!

indicators.note: fantastic means wild and fanciful, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Praising a performer: calling him a fantastic singer would suit him.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of SINGER and IT'D DO rearranged give the soul singer's name, and 'Fantastic singer' describes him too.
explanation.definitionFit: Otis Redding was the great American soul singer of '(Sittin' On) The Dock of the Bay'.

clue.text: Each male participating in smart form of underground crime?

indicators.note: participating in means these letters go inside the other word

parts.note: to smart is to sting

explanation.surface: Every man taking part in a clever kind of organised crime.
explanation.walkthrough: Steaming is a gang rushing through a crowd, such as a train carriage, robbing as they go; 'underground' hints at the London Tube.
explanation.definitionFit: Steaming is British slang for mass robbery by a gang charging through a crowd, often on trains.

clue.text: Security around university that may make someone blush

indicators.note: around means the security word wraps round the university letter

parts.note: gilts are gilt-edged securities, British government stocks

explanation.surface: Campus security might embarrass a student.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling guilt over wrongdoing is something that makes a person go red with shame.

clue.text: Island people place mark on a piece of wood

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: to place a mark on something is to tag it
a log is a piece of wood

explanation.surface: Islanders carve their mark into a timber.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tagalog are a people of Luzon in the Philippines, whose language underlies Filipino.

clue.text: Old works inspected daily but not completely

indicators.note: but not completely says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Ancient writings are examined every day, though only partly.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eddas are medieval Icelandic collections of Norse poetry and myth, old literary works.

clue.text: Ideas for revolution may start here — being red, by implication?

definitions.text: Ideas for revolution may start here — being red, by implication?

parts.words: Ideas for revolution may start here — being red, by implication?
parts.note: a place where radical ideas develop; red reads as the communist colour, and also as a hint at being bred

explanation.surface: A cell where revolutionary communist thinking is nurtured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being red' plays on BREED: red appears inside it, and red is the colour of revolution.
explanation.definitionFit: A breeding ground is a place or situation in which something, such as subversive ideas, develops.

clue.text: Giovanni has inner intention to be a good spirit?

indicators.note: has inner means the name holds the other word inside it

parts.note: Don Giovanni, so Giovanni points to DON, and Giovanni is also this puzzle's setter
an aim is an intention

explanation.surface: The setter claims that inside he means well, like a kindly spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: A daimon in Greek thought is a guardian or attendant spirit, often a benign one.

clue.text: Shop's exit?

parts.note: the word for a way out also names a retail store

explanation.surface: A question about the way out of a store.
explanation.definitionFit: An outlet is both a retail shop and a vent or opening through which something escapes.

clue.text: Mistake involving slack traditionalist

indicators.note: involving means the mistake word wraps round the other

parts.note: bish is British slang for a blunder
limp means slack

explanation.surface: An old-fashioned type makes an error through laziness.
explanation.walkthrough: Colonel Blimp was a pompous, reactionary British cartoon character.
explanation.definitionFit: Blimpish means pompously reactionary and old-fashioned, like a die-hard traditionalist.

clue.text: A hotel doubled up with laughter

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters read from bottom to top
doubled means the pair of letters is written twice

parts.note: H is hotel in the phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone at a hotel bent double with mirth.
explanation.definitionFit: Ha-ha is the written sound of a laugh.

clue.text: Instrumentalist's passionate desire to hold note

indicators.note: to hold means the desire word contains the note

parts.note: lust is passionate desire
TI is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A musician longs to sustain a note.
explanation.definitionFit: A lutist is a lute player, a kind of instrumentalist.

clue.text: Man leaves impressive house for holy hill

indicators.note: leaves means the man goes out of the house word

parts.note: a mansion is an impressive house

explanation.surface: A man quits his stately home for a sacred mount.
explanation.definitionFit: Sion, or Zion, is the hill of Jerusalem held sacred in the Bible.

clue.text: Befuddled old bands together falling over

indicators.note: falling over means the letters are turned round

parts.note: to band together is to unite, which is to knit

explanation.surface: Old musical groups reunite and topple over drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Stinko is slang for very drunk, a state of being befuddled.

clue.text: This Protestant, sir, could be seen as unrighteous

indicators.note: could be seen as means the answer plus sir, rearranged, look like the final word

explanation.surface: A French Protestant addressed as sir is judged sinful.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer's letters plus SIR rearrange into UNRIGHTEOUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Huguenots were French Calvinist Protestants of the 16th and 17th centuries.
